lines.text: Pizza is the best food, period.

data.define: Used to end a point with confidence.

example.text: Pizza is the best food, period.

misuse.text: Don't write 'periodt' in a school essay.
misuse.why: It's texting slang, not formal writing.

publish.title: What does "periodt" mean?
publish.value: Periodt = And that's final. Example: "Pizza is the best food, period." (very casual English, US).
